summary: Verified Round-1 mobile/tablet responsiveness (global CSS in index.css + flex-wrap on Issues header). All required checks pass on mobile (390x844), tablet (820x1180), and desktop regression (1920x800). No horizontal page overflow anywhere; tables scroll horizontally on mobile only; dialogs cap at 92vh and fit the screen; desktop tables remain full-width display:table (mobile block rule correctly scoped).

desktop_1920./leads_table: display:table (NOT block) PASS - mobile rule correctly not applied

critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' on complaint create dialog - not blocking, but a11y-nit; add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to the shadcn DialogContent.

Global rule `table { display: block; ... }` on <768px is broad; if any layout uses <table> for grid-like non-tabular structure it would collapse. Current CRM tables appear to be true data tables so this is acceptable, but worth a follow-up audit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 1 responsiveness (global CSS table block + dialog max-height + Issues header flex-wrap) is verified across mobile/tablet/desktop. Login via POST form on /login with the given creds redirects to /home. Sidebar becomes hamburger drawer on mobile - navigate via page.goto. Lead rows use data-testid=lead-cell-<id> (not <a> tags) for row click navigation.
